findings.text: follow-on: _settle_grace_default duplicates the parse-a-seconds-override-from-an-env-var-with-a-default capability already owned by reckon/mcp_deadlines.py:63 _positive_seconds and reckon/crew/dispatch_launch.py:2610 _terminal_manifest_grace_seconds; it neither calls nor extracts a shared owner, so a fourth copy of the same parse now exists.

follow-on: the _child_env change lands in a file outside the node's declared write paths; the manifest discloses it as a granted repair, but the run record's write_paths predate the grant so reckon crew check-manifest reports the run as writing outside its scope.

follow-on: the head-arm log's header names revision 625c713c7 while the manifest's after_suite records revision 451f7c9ca, so the log alone cannot be tied to the content it measured; the pairing rests on the manifest's gate_provenance claim and the separate focused arm at 451f7c9ca.

item_verdicts.diff: read commit by commit against base 7dd3203a547c38129fdaf14477d0d98307d2f446 -- fe8a8dc39 adds the grace and the emptiness reset, 6d2810526 the test that drives it, 3fdbea55c and 625c713c7 the evidence fragment and the figure, 451f7c9ca the per-arming environment seam and the child-env fix, 2a01b2d1a the closing record -- every path inside the declared scope but for the granted test file.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done_when names the three carved cases and the base/head gate; the manifest records 257 passed EXIT=0 at head and 2 failed at base, and the cases landed at tests/test_a_pane_does_not_settle_during_admission.py:222 (handover kept and the admitted start drawn), :292 (a population empty past the grace settles once and the idle line names the drain) and :347 (a queued request never settles).
item_verdicts.goal: the node's goal is to hold a follower's settle for a grace longer than an admission handover so an admitted run is drawn; reckon/crew_follow_commands.py:1451 ends the pane only once its population has held nothing unfinished for FOLLOWER_SETTLE_GRACE_SECONDS, and :1445 clears that emptiness on any sighting of live work so an admitted run keeps the pane.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it states status complete, the 25-file head gate at 257 passed EXIT=0, the base arm at 2 failed, the negative control at 3 failed and 1 passed, and it discloses under gate_provenance that the head-arm log's header names an earlier revision than the content it measured.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the manifest declares reckon/crew_follow_commands.py, tests/test_a_pane_does_not_settle_during_admission.py and the fragment and figure paths; the diff adds a fifth file, tests/test_a_pane_settles_when_no_work_is_live.py, which the manifest records as a coordinator repair-round grant outside the declared pair.

justifications.durability: with FOLLOWER_SETTLE_GRACE_SECONDS restored to the one-second hold the handover case at tests/test_a_pane_does_not_settle_during_admission.py:255 reddens with "the pane settled while an admitted run was still being placed", and :219 pins the constant, so both assertions fail when the change regresses.
justifications.evidence: the head gate at logs/head-arm-repair.log reads 257 passed EXIT=0 and the base arm at logs/base-arm.log reads 2 failed, recorded in the manifest's after_suite and baseline_suite; the head-arm log's header names revision 625c713c7 which predates commit 451f7c9ca, so the pairing of log to content rests on the manifest's gate_provenance claim and the separate focused arm at 451f7c9ca rather than on the log itself.
justifications.fit: the change extends the existing settle seam at reckon/crew_follow_commands.py:1406 with a per-arming grace, and its added names (FOLLOWER_SETTLE_GRACE_SECONDS, FOLLOWER_SETTLE_GRACE_ENV, _settle_grace_default) carry no version, plan or ticket label.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/crew_follow_commands.py:1442-1452 measures the pane's emptiness against the grace and clears it on any live sighting (:1445), so a run admitted inside the handover keeps the pane rather than being missed.
justifications.reuse: _settle_grace_default at reckon/crew_follow_commands.py:469 re-implements the env-parsed-seconds-with-default capability the repository already owns at reckon/mcp_deadlines.py:63 _positive_seconds and reckon/crew/dispatch_launch.py:2610 _terminal_manifest_grace_seconds without extending either owner.
justifications.scope_discipline: tests/test_a_pane_settles_when_no_work_is_live.py:537 is changed outside the node's four declared write paths, disclosed as a coordinator repair-round tests grant in the manifest's scope_grant line.
